{{Short description|Estonian environmentalist, nature writer and nature photographer}}

[[File:Hendrik Relve, 2008.jpg|thumb|Hendrik Relve]]
'''Hendrik Relve''' (born 18 July 1948 in [[Tallinn]]) is an [[Estonia]]n environmentalist, nature writer and nature photographer.<ref name="elu24.ee">{{cite web |title=Hendrik Relve annab nõu: kuidas oma vaimset maailma avardada |url=https://www.elu24.ee/203809/hendrik-relve-annab-nou-kuidas-oma-vaimset-maailma-avardada |website=Elu24 |access-date=13 June 2021 |language=et |date=2009-12-23}}</ref>

In 1971 he graduated from [[Estonian University of Life Sciences|Estonian Agricultural Academy]] in forest engineering, and in 1989 [[University of Tartu]] in journalism.<ref name="elu24.ee" />

Since 2002 he is the chief editor of magazine ''[[Eesti Mets]]''. He is the host of the [[Vikerraadio]]'s radio program "Kuula rändajat".<ref name="elu24.ee" />

Awards:
* 2001: [[Order of the White Star]], IV class.<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Hendrik Relve|url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/3553/hendrik-relve |website=www.president.ee |access-date=12 June 2021}}</ref>

==Filmography==
Filmography:<ref name="EFIS">{{cite web |title=Hendrik Relve - Eesti filmi andmebaas |url=https://www.efis.ee/et/inimesed/id/20120 |website=www.efis.ee |access-date=13 June 2021}}</ref>
* 2006: "Mets seob põlvkondi" (documental film; scenarist)
* 2013: "Metsa poole" (documental film; author)
* 2014: "Maastiku mustrid" (documental film; script author)	
* 2017: "Vaata rändajat" (documental film;, animated film; scenarist, operator, text reader)
